subject: Re: Kickoff: Dream Fields 3D asset demo
body:
Status.

Reproduction: done May 13 via the NGC container path. On our 40-prompt eval set we match release quality on CLIP retrieval score for 34/40 prompts; the misses are thin structures (chairs legs, wire objects) where geometry gets wispy.

Quality work since: the transmittance regularization weight is the big lever — raising it aggressively early then annealing gives us solid geometry on 5 of the 6 thin-structure failures without hurting the rest. Multi-view consistency holds up in turntable renders. Chiara's marching-cubes extraction produces usable meshes for about 80% of prompts; the rest need manual cleanup, which is fine for a designer-in-the-loop demo.

The honest risk for LRB: per-asset cost. We're at ~35 GPU-minutes per object at demo quality. Fine for the demo, not a product price point — the readout should frame the roadmap around distillation/amortization, not per-prompt optimization forever.

Tereza
